title: Feelings
description: Say how you feel and respond when someone else does.

questions.sentence: Aap aaj kaise hain?
options: Main aaj bahut khush hoon.
Main thoda udaas hoon.
Main abhi ghar par hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Main aaj bahut khush hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I am very happy today.

questions.sentence: Main aaj bahut khush hoon.
options: I am very happy today.
I am very sad today.
I am very tired today.
questions.correctAnswer: I am very happy today.

questions.sentence: Tum udaas kyun ho?
options: Mera dost Delhi chala gaya.
Mujhe chai bahut pasand hai.
Main roz subah jaldi uthta hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Mera dost Delhi chala gaya.
questions.translatedSentence: My friend has gone away to Delhi.

questions.sentence: Woh ladki aaj bahut udaas hai.
options: That girl is very sad today.
That girl is very happy today.
That girl is very busy today.
questions.correctAnswer: That girl is very sad today.

questions.sentence: Kya tum khush ho?
options: Haan, main bahut khush hoon.
Nahi, mujhe pata nahi hai.
Haan, main ghar ja raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, main bahut khush hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am very happy.

questions.sentence: Mera bhai aaj khush nahi hai.
options: My brother is not happy today.
My brother is not at home today.
My brother is not coming today.
questions.correctAnswer: My brother is not happy today.

questions.sentence: Meri behen ki shaadi ho rahi hai.
options: Yeh to bahut acchi khabar hai!
Yeh to bahut buri khabar hai.
Mujhe abhi office jaana hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Yeh to bahut acchi khabar hai!
questions.translatedSentence: That is really good news!

questions.sentence: Hum sab bahut khush hain.
options: We are all very happy.
We are all very sad.
We are all very tired.
questions.correctAnswer: We are all very happy.

questions.sentence: Aaj mera din accha nahi tha.
options: Mujhe sunkar dukh hua.
Mujhe sunkar khushi hui.
Main kal Jaipur ja raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Mujhe sunkar dukh hua.
questions.translatedSentence: I am sorry to hear that.

questions.sentence: Tum itne thake hue kyun ho?
options: Main saari raat kaam kar raha tha.
Main saari raat khush tha.
Mujhe yeh film bahut pasand hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main saari raat kaam kar raha tha.
questions.translatedSentence: I was working all night.

questions.sentence: Main aaj bahut thak gaya hoon.
options: I am very tired today.
I am very bored today.
I am very angry today.
questions.correctAnswer: I am very tired today.

questions.sentence: Tum gussa kyun ho?
options: Meri metro chhoot gayi.
Meri chai thandi hai.
Main tumhare saath chalunga.
questions.correctAnswer: Meri metro chhoot gayi.
questions.translatedSentence: I missed my metro.

questions.sentence: Mujhe yahan bahut bore ho raha hai.
options: I am very bored here.
I am very scared here.
I am very comfortable here.
questions.correctAnswer: I am very bored here.

questions.sentence: Kya tumhe dar lag raha hai?
options: Haan, mujhe thoda dar lag raha hai.
Haan, mujhe bahut bhookh lagi hai.
Nahi, main abhi so raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, mujhe thoda dar lag raha hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am a little scared.

questions.sentence: Mere papa mujh par gussa hain.
options: My father is angry with me.
My father is worried about me.
My father is waiting for me.
questions.correctAnswer: My father is angry with me.

questions.sentence: Mujhe raat mein akele dar lagta hai.
options: Koi baat nahi, main tumhare saath rahunga.
Koi baat nahi, main kal subah aaunga.
Tum aaj bahut khush lag rahe ho.
questions.correctAnswer: Koi baat nahi, main tumhare saath rahunga.
questions.translatedSentence: It's okay, I will stay with you.

questions.sentence: Woh aadmi kal bahut gussa ho gaya tha.
options: That man got very angry yesterday.
That man got very scared yesterday.
That man got very tired yesterday.
questions.correctAnswer: That man got very angry yesterday.

questions.sentence: Ghar par karne ke liye kuch nahi hai.
options: Chalo, bahar chai peene chalte hain.
Chalo, phir hum kal baat karte hain.
Haan, isiliye main gussa ho gaya.
questions.correctAnswer: Chalo, bahar chai peene chalte hain.
questions.translatedSentence: Come on, let's go out for tea.

questions.sentence: Aap aaj thoda pareshan lag rahe hain.
options: Haan, raat bhar mujhe neend nahi aayi.
Haan, mujhe yeh shehar bahut pasand hai.
Nahi, main Lucknow se aaya hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, raat bhar mujhe neend nahi aayi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I could not sleep all night.

questions.sentence: Kya sab kuch theek hai?
options: Is everything all right?
Is everyone at home?
Is this the right way?
questions.correctAnswer: Is everything all right?

questions.sentence: Tumhari tabiyat ab kaisi hai?
options: Ab pehle se kaafi behtar hai.
Ab mujhe bahut gussa aa raha hai.
Ab main tumhare ghar ja raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Ab pehle se kaafi behtar hai.
questions.translatedSentence: I am much better than before now.

questions.sentence: Mujhe batao, tum sach mein kaise ho.
options: Tell me, how are you really doing.
Tell me, where are you really going.
Tell me, what do you really want.
questions.correctAnswer: Tell me, how are you really doing.

questions.sentence: Aap chup kyun hain, kya baat hai?
options: Kuch nahi, bas thoda thak gaya hoon.
Kuch nahi, mujhe samosa bahut pasand hai.
Haan, main kal Jaipur ja raha tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Kuch nahi, bas thoda thak gaya hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Nothing, I am just a little tired.

questions.sentence: Kya tum kal se pareshan ho?
options: Have you been upset since yesterday?
Have you been here since yesterday?
Have you been working since yesterday?
questions.correctAnswer: Have you been upset since yesterday?

questions.sentence: Kya main aapse kuch pooch sakta hoon?
options: Haan zaroor, aap pooch lijiye.
Haan zaroor, main abhi nikal raha hoon.
Nahi, mujhe bahut bhookh lagi hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan zaroor, aap pooch lijiye.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes of course, please go ahead and ask.

questions.sentence: Aapko aaj kaisa mehsoos ho raha hai?
options: How are you feeling today?
How was your day today?
What are you doing today?
questions.correctAnswer: How are you feeling today?

questions.sentence: Tum theek to ho na?
options: Haan, main theek hoon, tum fikar mat karo.
Haan, main theek hoon, isiliye main gussa hoon.
Nahi, main Delhi mein rehta hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, main theek hoon, tum fikar mat karo.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am fine, do not worry.

questions.sentence: Mujhe lagta hai main yeh kaam nahi kar paunga.
options: Tum zaroor kar paoge, mujhe tum par bharosa hai.
Haan, tumhe koshish hi nahi karni chahiye.
Main kal se Hindi seekh raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Tum zaroor kar paoge, mujhe tum par bharosa hai.
questions.translatedSentence: You will definitely manage it, I believe in you.

questions.sentence: Chinta mat karo, sab theek ho jayega.
options: Do not worry, everything will be fine.
Do not leave, everything is ready.
Do not forget, everyone will come.
questions.correctAnswer: Do not worry, everything will be fine.

questions.sentence: Main apne exam mein fail ho gaya.
options: Koi baat nahi, agli baar accha hoga.
Koi baat nahi, mujhe bhi bore ho raha hai.
Bahut badhiya, tumhe mubarak ho!
questions.correctAnswer: Koi baat nahi, agli baar accha hoga.
questions.translatedSentence: It's all right, next time will go better.

questions.sentence: Tum akele nahi ho, main tumhare saath hoon.
options: You are not alone, I am with you.
You are not late, I am waiting for you.
You are not wrong, I am agreeing with you.
questions.correctAnswer: You are not alone, I am with you.

questions.sentence: Mujhe naye kaam se bahut dar lag raha hai.
options: Dheere dheere sab kuch aasaan ho jayega.
To phir tumhe yeh kaam chhod dena chahiye.
Mujhe abhi samosa aur chai chahiye.
questions.correctAnswer: Dheere dheere sab kuch aasaan ho jayega.
questions.translatedSentence: Little by little, everything will get easier.

questions.sentence: Rona band karo aur thoda paani pi lo.
options: Stop crying and drink some water.
Stop working and eat something.
Stop talking and listen to me.
questions.correctAnswer: Stop crying and drink some water.

questions.sentence: Aaj mera din bahut bura tha.
options: Aaiye, main aapke liye chai banata hoon.
Aaiye, aap mujhe paise de dijiye.
Isiliye main aapse gussa hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Aaiye, main aapke liye chai banata hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Come, let me make you some tea.

questions.sentence: Agar tumhe baat karni ho to main hamesha yahan hoon.
options: If you need to talk, I am always here.
If you want to go, I am always ready.
If you are tired, I am always at home.
questions.correctAnswer: If you need to talk, I am always here.

questions.sentence: Shukriya, tumne meri bahut madad ki.
options: Isme shukriya ki kya baat hai.
Haan, mujhe bhi bahut dar lag raha tha.
Nahi, main tumse baat nahi karunga.
questions.correctAnswer: Isme shukriya ki kya baat hai.
questions.translatedSentence: There is no need to thank me for this.

questions.sentence: Aapko kaisa khaana pasand hai?
options: Mujhe dal chawal sabse zyada pasand hai.
Mujhe kal subah Jaipur jaana hai.
Mujhe woh aadmi bilkul pasand nahi aaya.
questions.correctAnswer: Mujhe dal chawal sabse zyada pasand hai.
questions.translatedSentence: I like dal and rice the most.

questions.sentence: Subah ki chai ke bina mujhe accha nahi lagta.
options: I do not feel right without my morning tea.
I do not drink tea in the morning.
I do not like tea without sugar.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not feel right without my morning tea.

questions.sentence: Kya tumhe metro ki bheed pasand hai?
options: Nahi, mujhe bheed bilkul pasand nahi hai.
Haan, isiliye main auto rickshaw se aaya.
Nahi, main abhi Lucknow mein hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahi, mujhe bheed bilkul pasand nahi hai.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I do not like crowds at all.

questions.sentence: Main chahta hoon ki hum kal saath mein ghoomne jaayein.
options: I want us to go out together tomorrow.
I think we went out together yesterday.
I hope you will come to my house tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: I want us to go out together tomorrow.

questions.sentence: Tum chhutti mein kya karna chahte ho?
options: Main apne gaon jaana chahta hoon.
Main pichhle hafte gaon gaya tha.
Mujhe yeh kaam pasand nahi aaya tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Main apne gaon jaana chahta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I want to go to my village.

questions.sentence: Mujhe auto rickshaw se zyada metro pasand hai.
options: I like the metro more than the auto rickshaw.
I like the auto rickshaw more than the metro.
I take the metro because the auto rickshaw is expensive.
questions.correctAnswer: I like the metro more than the auto rickshaw.

questions.sentence: Kya aapko kal wali film pasand aayi?
options: Sach kahoon to mujhe bilkul pasand nahi aayi.
Sach kahoon to main abhi ghar par hoon.
Haan, isiliye mujhe raat mein dar lagta hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Sach kahoon to mujhe bilkul pasand nahi aayi.
questions.translatedSentence: To be honest, I did not like it at all.

questions.sentence: Kaash mujhe thoda aur samay mil jaata.
options: I wish I had got a little more time.
I hope I will get a little more time.
I think I need a little more time.
questions.correctAnswer: I wish I had got a little more time.

questions.sentence: Mujhe Delhi ki garmi bilkul pasand nahi hai.
options: Mujhe bhi nahi, mujhe sardi zyada acchi lagti hai.
Mujhe bhi nahi, isiliye main garmi mein ghoomta hoon.
Haan, isiliye main kabhi chai nahi peeta.
questions.correctAnswer: Mujhe bhi nahi, mujhe sardi zyada acchi lagti hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Me neither, I like the cold weather much more.

questions.sentence: Mujhe lagta hai ki Delhi Jaipur se behtar shehar hai.
options: Maaf kijiye, lekin main aapse sehmat nahi hoon.
Bilkul, isiliye main kabhi Delhi nahi gaya.
Haan, mujhe aaj bahut neend aa rahi hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Maaf kijiye, lekin main aapse sehmat nahi hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Excuse me, but I do not agree with you.

questions.sentence: Mujhe maaf kar dijiye, maine jaanbujhkar aisa nahi kaha tha.
options: Please forgive me, I did not say that on purpose.
Please forgive me, I did not come here on purpose.
Please listen to me, I did not want to leave.
questions.correctAnswer: Please forgive me, I did not say that on purpose.

questions.sentence: Aapki kya raay hai, kya hum abhi nikal jaayein?
options: Mere khayal se hume thoda aur intezaar karna chahiye.
Mere khayal se aapko chai bilkul pasand nahi hai.
Haan, isiliye main kal raat bahut gussa tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Mere khayal se hume thoda aur intezaar karna chahiye.
questions.translatedSentence: In my opinion, we should wait a little longer.

questions.sentence: Main aapki baat samajhta hoon, lekin main isse sehmat nahi hoon.
options: I understand your point, but I do not agree with it.
I understand your problem, but I cannot help you.
I heard what you said, but I did not understand it.
questions.correctAnswer: I understand your point, but I do not agree with it.

questions.sentence: Kal main gusse mein aapse bahut kuch bol gaya tha.
options: Koi baat nahi, hum sab kabhi kabhi gussa ho jaate hain.
Koi baat nahi, mujhe aapka naya ghar bahut pasand hai.
Haan, isiliye main kal Lucknow chala gaya tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Koi baat nahi, hum sab kabhi kabhi gussa ho jaate hain.
questions.translatedSentence: It's all right, we all get angry sometimes.

questions.sentence: Agar aap chahein to hum is baare mein baad mein baat kar sakte hain.
options: If you like, we can talk about this later.
If you want, we can go there together later.
If you agree, we can finish this work today.
questions.correctAnswer: If you like, we can talk about this later.

questions.sentence: Mujhe nahi lagta ki yeh sahi faisla hai.
options: Aap sahi keh rahe hain, mujhe bhi thoda shak hai.
Aap sahi keh rahe hain, mujhe yeh shehar pasand hai.
Mujhe kal raat se hi bahut sar dard ho raha hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Aap sahi keh rahe hain, mujhe bhi thoda shak hai.
questions.translatedSentence: You are right, I have some doubts about it too.

questions.sentence: Mujhe afsos hai ki maine aapka dil dukhaya.
options: I am sorry that I hurt your feelings.
I am sorry that I could not help you.
I am glad that I did not upset you.
questions.correctAnswer: I am sorry that I hurt your feelings.

questions.sentence: Kya hum is baat ko yahin khatam kar sakte hain?
options: Haan, main bhi ab is jhagde se thak gaya hoon.
Haan, mujhe roti sabzi bahut pasand hai.
Nahi, main aapse kal Delhi mein miloonga.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, main bhi ab is jhagde se thak gaya hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am tired of this argument too.
